content:
Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5 and related updates, but at the same time unexpectedly launched a second wave of betas, including iOS 26.6.1, macOS 26.6.2, and other versions.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 betas arrive

If you've been using Apple's beta software, you have two options today.

After a three-week wait, iOS 27 beta 5 has finally arrived, as Apple continues its summer preparations for the next major software release.

But Apple has also just pushed out a new round of betas for iOS 26 and related updates.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 beta 1 are now available.

It is rare for Apple to offer beta versions for such minor software updates. Typically, the company would simply release small update versions without prior notice.

These updates may be intended to replace larger-scale updates such as iOS 26.7. But regardless of the reason, Apple clearly believes it is necessary to release these new iOS 26 updates in beta form before making them available to the public.

The iOS 26.6.1 and other updates are expected to contain only security updates and bug fixes. If any specific changes are discovered, we will continue to follow up for you.

Note: If you have already upgraded your iPhone to iOS 27 beta, you will not see the option to install iOS 26.6.1. That option is only available for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still using iOS 26? Have you noticed any differences in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Let us know in the comments.
